## Problem

What is hard or impossible today? Who hits it?

## Proposal

The smallest change that solves it. Note whether it affects the MCP/REST/CLI
contracts or the compact response shapes.

## Alternatives

What else was considered, and why it loses.

## Scope check

- [ ] This keeps `recall-core` free of HTTP, MCP, and async runtime types
- [ ] One engine serves MCP, REST, and CLI
- [ ] The change can ship with tests and a documented migration if breaking
